note: Togo: nationals of every African state hold a valid passport and enter without a visa for up to 30 days (since 18 May 2026), once they have filled in the immigration form online at least 24 hours before arrival (not modelled); everyone else applies for an e-Visa at least five days ahead (up to 90 days); visas on arrival and express visas are suspended. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Togo Voyage platform's own notice and its list of the 55 exempt countries, which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on Morocco (30 days like the rest, not 90 by a bilateral rule) and Western Sahara (not among them, so an e-Visa).

sources.title: Togo Voyage (official platform of the Togolese Republic), home page notice
sources.said: ATTENTION !!! To allow the competent authorities to carry out optimization work on visa application procedures, visas on arrival and express visas are suspended until further notice. Henceforth, visa applications must be submitted at least 5 days before arrival on Togolese territory. For urgent requests, please contact the support service. All African nationals holding a valid passport may enter Togo without a visa for stays of up to 30 days, provided they have completed the immigration form at least 24 hours before arrival.
